description.summary: declare a capture a one-shot screenshot

protocol.description:
A compositor can keep chosen windows and layer surfaces out of screen sharing, a notification with a sign-in code or a password prompt, while still letting a screenshot the user asked for show them. Nothing in a capture protocol says which a capture is, and guessing from timing is unsafe, so a compositor treats every capture as a screencast, which masks those surfaces, unless its client declares it a one-shot screenshot with this protocol before its first frame.
A screenshot tool or portal that does not declare its captures sees the blocked surfaces masked, which is the safe direction.
